endpoints.scope: Tools registered with the default MCP server
Only tools assigned to the named context

initialization.instructions: Start with musoq_describe using operation 'bootstrap'. Search or read the smallest relevant Musoq capability, then use musoq_execute_query to run SQL. Runtime descriptions are optional, and inspect is an expert-only CLI path rather than a preflight.

discoveryTool.name: musoq_describe
discoveryTool.availability: Every MCP context and the default server

runtime.disclosure: Resolving source metadata may read source data. Musoq Cloud cannot determine or bound provider discovery.

compatibility.userDefinedTools: Remain context-scoped and are listed alongside system tools.

resources.description: Bounded start document for describe to run

toolFailures.transport: A tool failure is returned as a successful JSON-RPC result with isError true.

notes: MCP can be disabled through configuration; disabled endpoints return HTTP 503.
Tool availability is context-specific and must be discovered with tools/list.
Heading fragments are resolved by resources/read but are not individually emitted by resources/list.
The musoq_describe content block is Markdown and structuredContent carries the same format-version 1 semantic envelope.
Clients must not infer support for service routes that are absent from this contract.
